title: Make a verifier timeout a distinct unjudged outcome, retried once
summary: Retry of job 20261027-054228-k9ex (dispatched, never verified, no findings recorded): its candidate work in 7 files is kept as the starting point and finished with a rerun of a timed-out verifier plus tests. The root cause is that a verifier killed at its deadline was recorded as the generic `verifier_failure` and failed the verdict like a judged failure, so criteria were rejected unjudged (jobs 20261010-154005-jsdj, 20261018-120736-90w3, 20261018-133651-1ncn). Audience: the Athena operator reading verdicts.

defaults_applied.how: The fix is where the timeout is recorded and judged, not at one job.
New tests plus fmt, clippy and test criteria.
Tests assert the recorded verdict and reason.
Behavior criteria run named cargo test commands.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: I read crates/athena-core/src/run/verification.rs (verification_stage sets a plain-string verifier_failure at the budget, snapshot lock, could-not-run, non-Success outcome and no-valid-verdict points, and already reruns once on a system_fault), crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs (VerdictInputs.verifier_failure: Option<String>; judge pushes 'the verifier did not complete: ..' and makes the verdict fail when it is set) and crates/athena-core/src/run/send_back.rs (constructs VerdictInputs with verifier_failure: None). The property is measured directly by calling judge with the new failure value and by running verification_stage with a stub verifier. The change adds no record or data file under crates/, so check_record_file and AnyRecord are unaffected. It adds no refusal rule.

Job 20261027-054228-k9ex: its candidate changed 7 files, and all are kept as deliverables. It typed verifier_failure as Incomplete or TimedOut and gave the timeout an 'unjudged' reason. The candidate was never verified and recorded no findings, so there is nothing to fix. What was missing is that its rerun on timeout and its behavior tests are not shown, so this retry adds them.
A timeout is detected from the verifier invocation's recorded detail or outcome. The first timeout triggers one rerun, and the second leaves the result unjudged, not a pass.
The verdict stays non-passing when unjudged, but the reason text says 'unjudged', not 'rejected', and does not add 'returned no verdict'.
Previous out-of-scope items stay: no change to athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows or the verifier_timeout_s value, and no per-criterion saving or deadline scaling.

acceptance_criteria.text: The change description names the root cause: a verifier timeout was recorded as the generic `verifier_failure` in crates/athena-core/src/run/verification.rs and failed the verdict in crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs exactly like a judged failure, so criteria were rejected unjudged.

A Grep of the diff in crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs and crates/athena-core/src/run/verification.rs shows a distinct timeout variant whose reason says 'unjudged' and is separate from 'the verifier did not complete'; it never yields a pass.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core`. A new test where the verifier times out on the first run and succeeds on the second ends with the second run's verdict. A second test where it times out twice ends with the unjudged reason, not as a judged rejection. Both fail on the base commit and pass on the change.
Run `cargo test -p athena-core`. A new test shows that a non-timeout verifier failure, a failing check, or a judged fail verdict still fails the verdict with its existing reason.
Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test --locked`; all pass with no warnings.
outcome-check: the tests assert the verdict and reason recorded for a timed-out verifier, not only that types or wiring exist.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the new outcome, and docs/records.md and docs/design/athena-v0.md are updated where they describe the verifier-failure reason.

out_of_scope: Re-landing the candidate work of jobs 20261010-154005-jsdj, 20261018-120736-90w3 and 20261018-133651-1ncn (run.rs trailer, docs/spec.toml, xtask/tests/spec.rs, docs edits)
Changing athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows, including the verifier_timeout_s value
Saving each criterion's verdict as it is reached
Making the deadline scale with the cargo work
Changing the gate's reading of records
departures: Slightly higher cost than the reference because the change touches the verdict gate and needs new tests.
urgent_reason: Verifier timeouts caused three rejected jobs with all criteria unjudged; distinguishing and retrying them cuts failed attempts and redo-work.
hard_reason: Changes how verification records and judges a verifier outcome and reruns it, so it alters the verdict gate and run pipeline.
